"""Audit retained packaging and exact local full-run receipts; no test execution."""
from __future__ import annotations
import base64
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/workspace/scratch/d417066aafa8")
CHANGE = ROOT / "agent-dev-kit/docs/changes/20261118-owned-build-session"
EVIDENCE = CHANGE / "evidence"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "packaging-audit-result.json"
EXPECTED_HEAD = "5ff076a14c88c65132e44dd8bfdb4c2ab71ee4f8"
EXPECTED_TREE = "14e5482c9ea3f97abe6abfcc74f8251088e46e8e"

def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def unwrap(path):
    item = json.loads(path.read_text())
    raw = item["content"].encode("utf-8") if item["encoding"] == "utf-8" else base64.b64decode(item["content"], validate=True)
    assert len(raw) == item["bytes"], path
    assert sha(raw) == item["sha256"], path
    return item, raw

records = []
for index_path in sorted(EVIDENCE.rglob("index.json")):
    index = json.loads(index_path.read_text())
    checked = []
    source_dir = Path(index["source_directory"]) if "source_directory" in index else None
    for entry in index["records"]:
        target = index_path.parent / entry["path"]
        wrapper_bytes = target.read_bytes()
        assert sha(wrapper_bytes) == entry["wrapper_sha256"], target
        item, raw = unwrap(target)
        assert sha(raw) == entry["raw_sha256"] and len(raw) == entry["raw_bytes"], target
        matches_source = None
        if source_dir:
            original = source_dir / item["origin"]
            assert original.read_bytes() == raw, original
            matches_source = True
        checked.append({"path": str(target.relative_to(CHANGE)), "raw_sha256": sha(raw), "wrapper_sha256": sha(wrapper_bytes), "matched_original": matches_source})
    records.append({"index": str(index_path.relative_to(CHANGE)), "index_sha256": sha(index_path.read_bytes()), "count": len(checked), "checked": checked})

def payload(relative):
    return json.loads(unwrap(EVIDENCE / relative)[1])

before = payload("full/source-before.json.json")
after = payload("full/source-after.json.json")
summary = payload("full/summary.json.json")
stages = payload("full/results.json.json")
timing = payload("full/full-timing.json.json")
assert before == after
assert before["head"] == summary["head"] == EXPECTED_HEAD
assert before["tree"] == summary["tree"] == EXPECTED_TREE
assert before["tracked_status"] == "" and len(before["files"]) == 1082
assert summary["status"] == "pass" and summary["changed_sources"] == []
assert len(stages) == 8 and all(stage["exit_code"] == 0 for stage in stages)
for stage in stages:
    raw = unwrap(EVIDENCE / "full" / (stage["log"] + ".json"))[1]
    assert sha(raw) == stage["log_sha256"]
assert timing["total"] == timing["pass"] == 102 and timing["fail"] == 0
raw_full = unwrap(EVIDENCE / "full/full-regression.log.json")[1]
assert b"102" in raw_full
for relative in ("implementation/red-ninja/result.json.json", "implementation/red-late-status/result.json.json"):
    assert payload(relative)["exit_code"] == 1
for relative in ("implementation/green-module-final/result.json.json", "implementation/ruff-final/result.json.json"):
    item = payload(relative)
    assert item["exit_code"] == 0
    assert item["source_before_sha256"] == item["source_after_sha256"] == "a17791efaf2ad0dd7b0923dc49b4c219df0a3eb563495b419cc9de281cb12fc0"
independent = payload("independent/probe-result.json.json")
assert independent["all_accepted"] and independent["exit_code"] == 0
assert independent["checks"][0]["original_expected_defect_oracle_exit_code"] == 1
assert independent["checks"][0]["original_conclusion"] == "not-confirmed"
# Critical historical negatives must match their independently reviewed originals.
historical = {
    "main-attempt1-regression-failure-log.log.json": ROOT / "delivery-11.4.0/adk-release-audit/main-15fa31d1/failure-44116100760/regression-failure-log.log",
    "main-attempt2-regression-failure-log.log.json": ROOT / "delivery-11.4.0/adk-release-audit/main-15fa31d1/attempt2/regression-failure-log.log",
    "diagnosis-ninja-cleanup-probe-result.json.json": ROOT / "delivery-11.4.0/adk-ci-timeout-diagnosis/post-attempt2/ninja-cleanup-probe-result.json",
    "runtime-review.md.json": ROOT / "delivery-11.4.0/adk-ci-runtime-review/review.md",
}
for relative, source in historical.items():
    assert unwrap(EVIDENCE / "baseline" / relative)[1] == source.read_bytes()
report = {
    "completed_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "scope": "Read-only audit of source/run bindings and reversible evidence packaging; no product test reruns",
    "candidate": {"head": EXPECTED_HEAD, "tree": EXPECTED_TREE},
    "wrapper_count": sum(item["count"] for item in records),
    "direct_original_matches": sum(entry["matched_original"] is True for item in records for entry in item["checked"]) + len(historical),
    "indexes": records,
    "full": {"stage_count": len(stages), "stage_exit_codes": [stage["exit_code"] for stage in stages],
             "total": timing["total"], "pass": timing["pass"], "fail": timing["fail"],
             "timing_elapsed_ms": timing["elapsed_ms"], "stages": stages,
             "source_count": len(before["files"]), "source_before_equals_after": before == after,
             "full_log_sha256": sha(raw_full)},
    "negative_results_preserved": True,
    "independent_original_oracle_exit_1_preserved": True,
    "result": "pass",
}
assert not OUT.exists(), "Do not overwrite an observation"
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({key: value for key,value in report.items() if key not in ("indexes", "full")} | {"full": {key:value for key,value in report["full"].items() if key!="stages"}, "audit_sha256":sha(OUT.read_bytes())}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
